envelope.description: Add consumer-path integration cases (lease, vault guard) with real-exited-owner fixtures

body.title: Add consumer-path integration cases (lease, vault guard) with real-exited-owner fixtures
body.summary: Extend the integration suites with real-exited-owner fixtures (no fake reader - these paths call acquireRunFileGuard without injection): spawn a short-lived child process, wait for exit, write its recorded identity (current boot-id + the child's start ticks) into the guard's owner.json. src/daemon/__tests__/run-file-ownership.test.ts gains a startup-lease-over-dead-owner-guard case; src/daemon/__tests__/keystore-guard.test.ts gains a vault-guard reclaim case proving the offline maintenance path inherits the shared recovery through the real verdict.
acceptanceChecks: Lease acquires over a guard whose owner.json records a genuinely exited child process
Vault guard (PATHS.vaultGuard) reclaims a genuinely-exited-owner guard through the real readProcessIdentity verdict path

tests.name: startup lease acquires over a guard whose owner.json records a genuinely exited child process (src/daemon/__tests__/run-file-ownership.test.ts)
vault guard reclaims a genuinely-exited-owner guard through the real readProcessIdentity verdict path (src/daemon/__tests__/keystore-guard.test.ts)
